description: Final end-to-end re-run of the decisive CX5R alignment with live UniProt sequences, plus the exhaustive CX5R scan of Q12454
code:
# Final self-contained re-run of the decisive analysis, so that code and output sit together.
# Fetches sequences live from UniProt, aligns each comparator to S. cerevisiae Siw14 (P53965)
# with Needleman-Wunsch / BLOSUM62 / affine gaps, and reads off the residues that sit at the
# Siw14 catalytic Cys214 and invariant Arg220 columns.
import requests, numpy as np, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ACC = {"ScOca6":"Q12454","ScOca1":"P50946","ScOca2":"P53949","ScSiw14":"P53965",
       "SpSiw14":"Q9UUF3","AtDSP1":"Q9ZVN4","AtDSP2":"Q84MD6","AtDSP4":"Q940L5",
       "HsDUSP3":"P51452","HsLaforin":"O95278"}
SEQ={}
for n,a in ACC.items():
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    SEQ[n]="".join(t.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
print("sequence lengths:", {n:len(s) for n,s in SEQ.items()})

# BLOSUM62
B62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
rows=B62.strip().split("\n"); hdr=rows[0].split()
M={}
for r in rows[1:]:
    p=r.split(); M[p[0]]={hdr[i]:int(p[i+1]) for i in range(len(hdr))}
def sc(a,b): return M.get(a,{}).get(b,-4)

def nw_affine(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    Mx=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    Pm=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); Px=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); Py=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mx[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); Px[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); Py[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1])
            cand=(Mx[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]); k=int(np.argmax(cand))
            Mx[i,j]=cand[k]+s; Pm[i,j]=k
            cand=(Mx[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge,Iy[i-1,j]+go); k=int(np.argmax(cand))
            Ix[i,j]=cand[k]; Px[i,j]=k
            cand=(Mx[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge); k=int(np.argmax(cand))
            Iy[i,j]=cand[k]; Py[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([Mx[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); score=max(Mx[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m])
    A1=[];A2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0:
            A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append(s2[j-1]);st=Pm[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1:
            A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append("-");st=Px[i,j];i-=1
        else:
            A1.append("-");A2.append(s2[j-1]);st=Py[i,j];j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(A1)),"".join(reversed(A2)),score

REF="ScSiw14"; CATC=214; INVR=220   # 1-based positions in P53965
assert SEQ[REF][CATC-1]=="C" and SEQ[REF][INVR-1]=="R", "reference positions wrong"

rows_out=[]
for name in ["ScOca6","ScOca1","ScOca2","SpSiw14","AtDSP1","AtDSP2","AtDSP4","HsDUSP3","HsLaforin"]:
    a_q,a_r,s = nw_affine(SEQ[name],SEQ[REF])
    # walk the alignment, tracking 1-based indices in each sequence
    qi=ri=0; at_c=at_r=None; qpos_c=qpos_r=None
    for k in range(len(a_r)):
        if a_q[k]!="-": qi+=1
        if a_r[k]!="-": ri+=1
        if a_r[k]!="-" and ri==CATC: at_c=a_q[k]; qpos_c=qi if a_q[k]!="-" else None
        if a_r[k]!="-" and ri==INVR: at_r=a_q[k]; qpos_r=qi if a_q[k]!="-" else None
    ident=sum(1 for k in range(len(a_q)) if a_q[k]==a_r[k] and a_q[k]!="-")
    cols=sum(1 for k in range(len(a_q)) if a_q[k]!="-" and a_r[k]!="-")
    rows_out.append(dict(protein=name, acc=ACC[name], score=s, pid=100*ident/cols,
                         cat=f"{at_c}{qpos_c}", inv=f"{at_r}{qpos_r}",
                         cys_ok=(at_c=="C"), arg_ok=(at_r=="R")))

print("\n%-11s %-8s %8s %7s  %-8s %-8s %-7s %-7s"%("protein","acc","NWscore","%id","at C214","at R220","CysOK","ArgOK"))
for r in rows_out:
    print("%-11s %-8s %8.1f %7.1f  %-8s %-8s %-7s %-7s"%(
        r["protein"],r["acc"],r["score"],r["pid"],r["cat"],r["inv"],r["cys_ok"],r["arg_ok"]))

# exhaustive CX5R scan of Oca6
q=SEQ["ScOca6"]
print("\nExhaustive CX5R scan of Q12454 (%d aa):"%len(q))
for i,ch in enumerate(q):
    if ch=="C" and i+6<len(q):
        print("  C%-4d +6 = %s   CX5R: %s"%(i+1,q[i+6],q[i+6]=="R"))
print("  regex C.{5}R anywhere :", bool(re.search(r"C.{5}R",q)))
print("  regex C.{5}R[ST]      :", bool(re.search(r"C.{5}R[ST]",q)))

# ---- figure built only from the numbers just computed ----
names=[r["protein"] for r in rows_out]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
cols=["#c0392b" if not r["arg_ok"] else "#2c7fb8" for r in rows_out]
ax[0].barh(range(len(rows_out)),[r["pid"] for r in rows_out],color=cols)
ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(rows_out))); ax[0].set_yticklabels(names)
ax[0].invert_yaxis(); ax[0].set_xlabel("percent identity to ScSiw14 over aligned columns")
ax[0].set_title("Needleman-Wunsch alignment to ScSiw14 (P53965)")
for i,r in enumerate(rows_out):
    ax[0].text(r["pid"]+0.6,i,f'{r["cat"]} / {r["inv"]}',va="center",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xlim(0,70)

ok=[1 if r["arg_ok"] else 0 for r in rows_out]
cy=[1 if r["cys_ok"] else 0 for r in rows_out]
x=np.arange(len(rows_out))
ax[1].bar(x-0.19,cy,0.38,label="catalytic Cys present",color="#2c7fb8")
ax[1].bar(x+0.19,ok,0.38,label="invariant Arg present",color="#e67e22")
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels(names,rotation=45,ha="right")
ax[1].set_yticks([0,1]); ax[1].set_yticklabels(["absent","present"])
ax[1].set_title("CX5R P-loop residues at the ScSiw14 C214 and R220 columns")
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower left")
ax[1].annotate("Oca6: Ile120",xy=(0.19,0),xytext=(1.1,0.45),fontsize=9,color="#c0392b",
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#c0392b"))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
